verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable rules or event-triggered automation in Ente Auth. Automatic daily backups are a fixed built-in toggle rather than user-authored rules. The CLI-driven backup and the enteauth://search deep links are building blocks a user could script around, not a rules engine, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
